evidenceSource: Deliberate noindex. This is a B2B sales page for a paid product, reached from cold outreach and from emails quoting a branded demo link — not from search.
reason: Same rationale as /services and /demo: the page exists to convert a named prospect who arrived from an email, not to attract organic traffic. It competes for no keyword and carries no content that belongs in the index.

gscEvidence.note: Page did not exist before this change, so there is no GSC history to cite.

internalLinks: /embed/mortgage-calculator?brand=demo (live branded sample linked from the hero)
conversionPath: Hero demo link -> pricing -> mailto or checkout
alternativesConsidered: Indexing it would compete with /calculators pages for 'financial calculators' queries, which are already thin, and would dilute the crawl budget the indexed calculator pages need.
